missions.title: Link Up

objectives.arriveText: Change of plans, too many eyes here. Meet me at Trinity Square, behind the Eaton Centre.

missions.doneText: Good looks for coming out. Twenty for your TTC. I'll hit you with something real soon.

missions.title: Ma's Errand

objectives.text: Pick up Baba's prescription at Shoppers Drug Mart

missions.doneText: Thank you beta. Come home safe, don't stay out with that boy all night.

missions.title: The Package

objectives.text: Grab the bag by the Sankofa Square subway entrance
objectives.arriveText: You got it? Don't open it. Victoria Street garage, now.

objectives.text: Drop the bag at the 300 Victoria Street Garage

missions.doneText: Clean. Sixty's yours. Keep your head down for a bit.
